The Alliance.name: The Alliance
The Alliance.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.Ua2ouafYe2hy1iS6 caption=false cite=false classes="size-three margin-center noborder"]

The peoples of the Alliance are bound together by proud traditions of nobility, honor, faith, justice, and sacrifice. The disparate cultures that make up this faction contribute technical, arcane, and spiritual wisdom toward the goal of a peaceful and just world. The highest ideals of the Alliance are tradition, justice, and duty, matching closely to the Lawful Good alignment.

The Alliance is a military coalition whose leadership is dependent on the unified will of its member peoples. By default, the high king (or other leader) of Stormwind has served as commander of the Alliance, but the commander has authority over only the military forces that other Alliance leaders commit to the Alliance’s cause. Thus, in practice, the human king leads as part of a council made up of all the Alliance leaders.

Exodar Renown Perks.name: Exodar Renown Perks
Exodar Renown Perks.text:
The Exodar faction represents the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDraenei000000]{draenei} who came to Azeroth aboard that vessel under the leadership of Prophet Velen, as well as the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDraenei000000.JournalEntryPage.8N42L6yKr7bsJ8I3]{Lightforged draenei} of the Vindicaar.

While your Bastion is within the Exodar, within the Vindicaar, or on the Azuremyst Isles, your Renown Score with the Exodar @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowExodarBastion]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Exodar gives you the following additional benefits.

Exodar: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Exodar

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn the Draenei language or gain proficiency with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulGlassblowe]{Glassblower’s Tools} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulJewelersTo]{Jeweler’s Tools} (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar).

Exodar: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Exodar

When you use @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.7ekbPmuT21XfF3GN#jewelcrafting]{jewelcrafting} to craft an item, the time required to craft it is halved.

Exodar: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Exodar

You can request a Charm from the leaders of the Exodar before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCharmOfHerois]{Charm of Heroism}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCharmOfRestor]{Charm of Restoration}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCharmOfVitali]{Charm of Vitality} (your choice; see the Dungeon Master’s Guide), which lasts until you expend it or you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request a Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Exodar increases.

Exodar: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Exodar

You can call on fifty draenei soldiers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorInfantr]{Warrior Infantry}) led by three sergeants (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorVeteran]{Warrior Veterans}) and one commander (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorCommand]{Warrior Commander}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Exodar increases.

Darnassus Renown Perks.name: Darnassus Renown Perks
Darnassus Renown Perks.text:
The Darnassus faction represents the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowElf0000000000.JournalEntryPage.C4fRQxnWgEHPPK1W]{night elves} of Azeroth, wherever they actually reside, who acknowledge the leadership of Shandris Feathermoon (in the present age) or her parents, High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage. The faction also encompasses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowElf0000000000.JournalEntryPage.RMfuWvj6ufycMJo0]{void elves} led by Alleria Windrunner, based in Telogrus Rift.

While your Bastion is in Darnassus or Teldrassil (or in Bel’ameth or Amirdrassil after the destruction of Teldrassil), your Renown Score with Darnassus @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowDarnassusBast]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Darnassus gives you the following additional benefits.

Training

Several renown perks give you the opportunity to work with a trainer to learn a language or gain a proficiency. The days required needn’t be consecutive, but you must spend 8 consecutive hours with the trainer for a day to count. You can gain only one tool proficiency from each renown perk.

Darnassus: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Darnassus

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Darnassian or Thalassian or to gain proficiency with the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulHerbalismK]{Herbalism Kit} (see the “Training” sidebar).

Darnassus: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Darnassus

When you succeed on a check to gather herbs using @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.ywSgJFsinrEDfTDk#herbalism]{herbalism}, you gain one extra resource, and you find a rare resource if you beat the check DC by 4 or more.

Darnassus: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Darnassus

You can request a Blessing from the leaders of Darnassus before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive one of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50#blessings]{Blessings} described in the Dungeon Master’s Guide (your choice), and it lasts until you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request this Blessing, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Darnassus increases.

Darnassus: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Darnassus

You can call on a Warden (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmQuestingKnight]{Questing Knight}), a leading Sentinel (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorCommand]{Warrior Commander}) with three Sentinel scouts (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmScoutCaptain00]{Scout Captains}), or a leading priestess of Elune (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmArchpriest0000]{Archpriest}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Darnassus increases.

Gilneas Renown Perks.name: Gilneas Renown Perks
Gilneas Renown Perks.text:
The Gilneas faction represents the nation of Gilneas and its people, including its worgen. Its leader is Queen Tess Greymane since the abdication of her father, Genn Greymane.

While your Bastion is anywhere in Gilneas, your Renown Score with Gilneas @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowGilneasBastio]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Gilneas gives you the following additional benefits.

Gilneas: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Gilneas

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Common or Common Sign Language or gain proficiency with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulLeatherwor]{Leatherworker’s Tools} (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Gilneas: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Gilneas

You gain a +2 bonus to ability checks you make to @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.ywSgJFsinrEDfTDk#skinning]{skin} a creature.

Gilneas: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Gilneas

You can request a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCharmOfAnimal]{Charm of Animal Conjuring} from the leaders of Gilneas before you undertake a quest on their behalf, which lasts until you expend it or you complete or abandon the quest. When you use the Charm, the conjured animal spirits appear as worgen spirits from the Emerald Dream. Once you request a Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Gilneas increases.

Gilneas: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Gilneas

You can call on a pack of six worgen skirmishers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmBerserker00000]{Berserkers}) with one leader (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmBerserkerComma]{Berserker Commander}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Gilneas increases.

Gnomeregan Renown Perks.name: Gnomeregan Renown Perks
Gnomeregan Renown Perks.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.3hTpdiTV57U4niG9 caption=false classes="float-right size-three noborder"]

The Gnomeregan faction encompasses gnomes and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowGnome00000000.JournalEntryPage.4OFFV6SmsonDI0kZ]{mechagnomes} who acknowledge the leadership of King Gelbin Mekkatorque. (Before the reclamation of Gnomeregan, the faction was known as Gnomeregan Exiles.) Most of them live in Tinkertown (a neighborhood of Ironforge) or the settlement of New Tinkertown.

While your Bastion is in Gnomeregan, in New Tinkertown, or on Mechagon Island, your Renown Score with Gnomeregan @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowGnomereganBas]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Gnomeregan gives you the following additional benefits.

Gnomeregan: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Gnomeregan

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Gnomish or gain proficiency with Tinker’s Tools (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Gnomeregan: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Gnomeregan

When you use @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.7ekbPmuT21XfF3GN#engineering]{engineering} to craft an item, the time required to craft it is halved.

Gnomeregan: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Gnomeregan

You can request a complicated engineering device from the leaders of Gnomeregan before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a mechanical device that functions as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfWonder0]{Wand of Wonder}, but it can’t regain charges, and it explodes dramatically but harmlessly when its last charge is expended. The device doesn’t require Attunement, but it functions only for you.

Gnomeregan: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Gnomeregan

In recognition of your service to gnomekind, you are given a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmShieldGuardian]{Shield Guardian} that serves you. If your Renown Score with Gnomeregan falls below 50, the guardian turns on you.

Obsidian Warders Renown Perks.name: Obsidian Warders Renown Perks
Obsidian Warders Renown Perks.text:
The Obsidian Warders is the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDracthyr00000.JournalEntryPage.XQNim1D5Yywg4kS4]{dracthyr} weyrn that has joined the Alliance, led by Scalecommander Azurathel.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Obsidian Warders gives you the following additional benefits.

Obsidian Warders: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Obsidian Warders

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Draconic or gain proficiency in History (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Obsidian Warders: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Obsidian Warders

You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowSightOfTheEar]{Sight of the Earth-Warder}. This Blessing gives you Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks. You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Obsidian Warders falls below 10.

Obsidian Warders: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Obsidian Warders

You can request a Blessing from the leaders of the Obsidian Warders before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBlessingOfPro]{Blessing of Protection} (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide), and it lasts until you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request this Blessing, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Obsidian Warders increases.

Obsidian Warders: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Obsidian Warders

You can call on a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowBlackDragonpP]{Black Dragonflight Whelp} (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowBestiaryOfAze]{chapter 7}) to assist you for a single adventure. If the dragon is killed, your Renown Score with the Obsidian Warders is reduced by [[/r 2d6]]. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Obsidian Warders increases.

Ironforge Renown Perks.name: Ironforge Renown Perks
Ironforge Renown Perks.text:
The Ironforge faction encompasses dwarves who acknowledge the leadership of the Council of Three Hammers, the government formed by the union of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDwarf00000000.JournalEntryPage.mFqlS1yykpwImnrp]{Bronzebeard}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDwarf00000000.JournalEntryPage.Ctzza0M3S3xta3Gv]{Dark Iron}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDwarf00000000.JournalEntryPage.cyFq9ds161YyDy5W]{Wildhammer} clans, which includes some @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDwarf00000000.JournalEntryPage.J2akKvYqui8VtL2y]{Frostborn} and other dwarves who are affiliated with the Alliance.

While your Bastion is in Ironforge, elsewhere in Khaz Modan (except gnome settlements), in or near Aerie Peak, or in Shadowforge City, your Renown Score with Ironforge @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowIronforgeBast]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Ironforge gives you the following additional benefits.

Ironforge: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Ironforge

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Dwarven or gain proficiency with Mason’s Tools or Smith’s Tools (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Ironforge: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Ironforge

When you use @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.7ekbPmuT21XfF3GN#blacksmithing]{blacksmithing} to craft an item, the time required to craft it is halved.

Ironforge: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Ironforge

You can request a dwarven relic from the leaders of Ironforge before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBeltOfDwarven]{Belt of Dwarvenkind}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDwarvenPlate0]{Dwarven Plate}, or a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgDwarvenThrowe]{Dwarven Thrower} (your choice). You must return the relic on the completion of the quest; failure to do so reduces your Renown Score with Ironforge by [[/r 1d8]].

Ironforge: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Ironforge

You can call on fifty dwarf soldiers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorInfantr]{Warrior Infantry}) led by three sergeants (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorVeteran]{Warrior Veterans}) and one commander (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorCommand]{Warrior Commander}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Ironforge increases.

Stormwind Renown Perks.name: Stormwind Renown Perks
Stormwind Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowHuman00000000.JournalEntryPage.592An0ENopmrf0AR]{Stormwind} faction encompasses the remnants of most of the human kingdoms of Azeroth, including @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowHuman00000000.JournalEntryPage.b5Jfulr9rBcvQYN9]{Kul Tiras}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowHuman00000000.JournalEntryPage.6Qdz0upjGNKOEfUj]{Dalaran} (but see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowKirinTor00000]{Kirin Tor} later in this chapter), and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowHuman00000000.JournalEntryPage.O9p7hdJXavAFDVD8]{Stromgarde} but excluding Gilneas. Stormwind remains the strongest human nation on Azeroth, under the leadership of Anduin Wrynn (and the regent of Stormwind, Turalyon, in his absence). Lady Jaina Proudmoore of Kul Tiras and Danath Trollbane of the League of Arathor (in the rebuilt Stromgarde Keep) acknowledge Stormwind’s place as the keystone of the Alliance.

While your Bastion is in Elwynn Forest, Kul Tiras, Stormwind City, Stromgarde, or Westfall, your Renown Score with Stormwind @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowStormwindBast]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Stormwind gives you the following additional benefits.

Stormwind: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Stormwind

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Common or Common Sign Language or gain proficiency with Weaver’s Tools (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Stormwind: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Stormwind

When you use @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.7ekbPmuT21XfF3GN#tailoring]{tailoring} to craft an item, the time required to craft it is halved.

Stormwind: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Stormwind

You can request a supernatural gift from the leaders of Stormwind before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive any @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50#blessings]{Blessing} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50#charms]{Charm} from the Dungeon Master’s Guide, and it lasts until you complete or abandon the quest or expend it. Once you request this gift, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Stormwind increases.

Stormwind: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Stormwind

You can call on Stormwind forces to assist you for a single adventure. You receive your choice of one of the following groups:

  • Fifty human soldiers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorInfantr]{Warrior Infantry}) led by three sergeants (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorVeteran]{Warrior Veterans}) and one commander (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWarriorCommand]{Warrior Commander})

  • Three SI:7 agents (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmScoutCaptain00]{Scout Captains}) and their leader (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmSpyMaster00000]{Spy Master})

  • A champion of the Holy Light (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmQuestingKnight]{Questing Knight})

  • A Kul Tiran admiral (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmPirateAdmiral0]{Pirate Admiral}) with a Warship (you must hire the ship’s crew)

Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Stormwind increases.

Tushui Renown Perks.name: Tushui Renown Perks
Tushui Renown Perks.text:
The Tushui faction, led by Aysa Cloudsinger, represents those @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowPandaren00000.JournalEntryPage.yf2GI7Vl0OD3Wsh4]{pandaren} who have given their allegiance to the Alliance.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Tushui gives you the following additional benefits.

Tushui: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Tushui

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn the Pandaren language or gain proficiency with Brewer’s Supplies or Cook’s Utensils (see the @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Tushui: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Tushui

If you spend a Short Rest in silent meditation, you gain Heroic Inspiration when you finish the rest.

Tushui: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Tushui

You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBlessingOfUnd]{Blessing of Understanding} (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide). You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Tushui falls below 25.

Tushui: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Tushui

A Tushui monk establishes a Meditation Chamber special facility in your Bastion. This facility doesn’t count toward the total number of special facilities in your Bastion. The monk departs and the facility becomes unusable if your Renown Score with the Tushui falls below 50.

Alliance Subfactions.name: Alliance Subfactions
Alliance Subfactions.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.F2Fe2NVxj0c0EHs9 classes="noborder"]

The Alliance is made up of members of many different species, and the most prominent among those species are the subfactions of the Alliance. Most of these subfactions are named for their capital city, as shown on the list below. The species descriptions in chapter 2 provide more information about these subfactions.

Alliance Subfactions

  • @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Darnassus} (night elves)

  • @UUID[.xwHnObtfS8KGOgNp]{Exodar} (draenei)

  • @UUID[.2FXXqAU9F2TQfPLo]{Gilneas} (worgen)

  • @UUID[.bbKM8aDik71xsqGu]{Gnomeregan} (gnomes)

  • @UUID[.oyPozuVXGusZiqIe]{Ironforge} (dwarves)

  • @UUID[.yXicda4EWoJxjOOi]{Obsidian Warders} (dracthyr)

  • @UUID[.w20Iuh5ocASVxvhS]{Stormwind} (humans)

  • @UUID[.ilOLdiGjFqiEtSlG]{Tushui} (pandaren)

If your species gives you a starting Renown Score with an Alliance subfaction, gaining renown with different Alliance subfactions also increases your Renown Score with your starting faction as described below:

Friendly. The first time your Renown Score with each Alliance faction other than your starting faction reaches 3, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 1.

Honored. The first time your Renown Score with each Alliance faction other than your starting faction reaches 10, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 2.

Revered. The first time your Renown Score with each Alliance faction other than your starting faction reaches 25, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 3.

Exalted. The first time your Renown Score with each Alliance faction other than your starting faction reaches 50, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 5.

Alliance Renown Perks.name: Alliance Renown Perks
Alliance Renown Perks.text:
The Alliance consists of many subfactions. Instead of having a Renown Score with the Alliance, characters gain renown perks based on their Renown Scores with the subfactions of the Alliance, as described below. The perks listed in @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowFactionsAndRe.JournalEntryPage.ekMmNzE3gyXsUtQY]{General Renown Perks} apply to specific subfactions, not to the Alliance as a whole.

Alliance: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Any Alliance Subfaction

Creatures associated with the Alliance are &Reference[Friendly] to you by default.

Alliance: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Any Alliance Subfaction

If your Bastion is in territory controlled by the Alliance, when you issue the Maintain order to your Bastion, the DM rolls twice on the Bastion Events table, and you pick which event occurs.

Ambassador of the Alliance

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with @UUID[.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Darnassus}, the @UUID[.xwHnObtfS8KGOgNp]{Exodar}, @UUID[.2FXXqAU9F2TQfPLo]{Gilneas}, @UUID[.bbKM8aDik71xsqGu]{Gnomeregan}, @UUID[.oyPozuVXGusZiqIe]{Ironforge}, and @UUID[.w20Iuh5ocASVxvhS]{Stormwind}

You have the title Ambassador of the Alliance. You can gain an audience with the leader of any Alliance subfaction at any time, and you can summon the leaders of the Alliance forces into council, given 1 week’s notice. For a worthy cause, any or all of these leaders will commit troops to aid you, at the DM’s discretion. You can also call on @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowAlleriaWindf2]{Alleria Windrunner}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowAnduinWrynnEj]{Anduin Wrynn}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowJainaProudmiL]{Jaina Proudmoore} (all described in @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowBestiaryOfAze]{chapter 7}) to assist you on one adventure.

The Horde.name: The Horde
The Horde.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.CKZXNH6uTMElXkCB caption=false cite=false classes="size-three margin-center noborder"]

The proud nations of the Horde are loosely joined in an alliance of convenience against a hostile world that would see them destroyed. Focused and ferocious, the Horde values strength and honor but struggles to keep its members’ aggression in check. The Horde’s ideals are unity, freedom, and hope, matching closely to the Chaotic Good alignment.

From the time of its founding until the end of the Fourth War, the Horde was led by a single warchief. The orc shaman Thrall held that position from before the Third War until he stepped down to join the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowEarthenRing00]{Earthen Ring} during the Cataclysm. He was succeeded by the warmongering Garrosh Hellscream, who was in turn deposed by a combination of Alliance pressure and a rebellion of the Darkspear trolls. The troll chieftain Vol’jin then took up the mantle, becoming the first non-orc to hold the title, but Vol’jin died during the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.mOeoKWAu3OOx8LP9]{Burning Legion}’s third invasion of Azeroth. The undead high elf Sylvanas Windrunner then became warchief, but she ultimately abandoned the Horde to pursue her own agenda. Since her departure, a Horde Council made up of the leaders of the Horde’s subfactions has governed the Horde.

Horde Renown Perks.name: Horde Renown Perks
Horde Renown Perks.text:
The Horde is composed of subfactions. Instead of having a Renown Score with the Horde, characters gain renown perks based on their Renown Scores with the subfactions of the Horde, as described below. The perks listed in “General Renown Perks” apply to specific subfactions, not to the Horde as a whole.

Horde: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Any Horde Subfaction

Creatures associated with the Horde are &Reference[Friendly] to you by default.

Horde: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Any Horde Subfaction

If your Bastion is in territory controlled by the Horde, when you issue the Maintain order to your Bastion, the DM rolls twice on the Bastion Events table, and you can pick which event occurs.

Ambassador of the Horde

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with @UUID[.KTz4fgoqdKuVuqzy]{Bilgewater Cartel}, @UUID[.zGI02pOayz0wbpis]{Darkspear Tribe}, @UUID[.eTA6s4DmPfXkn2ni]{Orgrimmar}, @UUID[.2EWR8vxGjhK2Dq6O]{Silvermoon City}, @UUID[.dy8Z8Gtvbu98gfQc]{Thunder Bluff}, and @UUID[.D1xIeKZnjR4CPjIb]{Undercity}

You carry the title Ambassador of the Horde. You can gain an audience with the leader of any Horde subfaction at any time, and you can summon the leaders of the Horde forces into council, given 1 week’s notice. For a worthy cause, any or all of these leaders will commit troops to aid you, at the DM’s discretion. You can also call on @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowSylvanasWinqT]{Sylvanas Windrunner} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowThrallGZRj1Vq]{Thrall} (both described in @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowBestiaryOfAze]{chapter 7}) to assist you on one adventure.

Bilgewater Cartel Renown Perks.name: Bilgewater Cartel Renown Perks
Bilgewater Cartel Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacBilgewCart]{Bilgewater Cartel} represents goblins aligned with the Horde. The cartel’s capital is Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara, and it has significant holdings across Azeroth. The cartel’s leader is Trade Prince Monte Gazlowe, who succeeded Jastor Gallywix in that role after Jastor abandoned the cartel. The cartel’s business has been described as “the classical goblin arts: building things and blowing them up.” Engineering, construction, infrastructure, and demolitions are all in the Bilgewater wheelhouse.

While your Bastion is in Bilgewater Harbor or any other Bilgewater holding, your Renown Score with the Bilgewater Cartel @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowBilgewaterCar]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Bilgewater Cartel gives you the following additional benefits.

Bilgewater Cartel: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Bilgewater Cartel

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn the Goblin language or gain proficiency with Alchemist’s Supplies (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Bilgewater Cartel: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Bilgewater Cartel

When you use alchemy to craft an item (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn]{chapter 3}), the time required to craft it is halved.

Bilgewater Cartel: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Bilgewater Cartel

You can request a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowClockwerkChar]{Clockwerk Charm} from the leaders of the Bilgewater Cartel before you undertake a quest on their behalf. This Charm allows you to cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonCons]{Summon Construct} spell (Metal only), which lasts for 1 hour and doesn’t require Concentration. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobConstructS]{Construct Spirit} appears as a mechanical goblin. When it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends, the summoned spirit explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere of fire. Creatures in the Sphere make a [[/save dex 13 format=long]], taking [[/damage 2d6 Fire average]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The Charm lasts until you use it once or you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request this Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Bilgewater Cartel increases.

Bilgewater Cartel: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Bilgewater Cartel

You can call on a cartel captain (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmPirateAdmiral0]{Pirate Admiral}) with six crew members (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmPirate00000000]{Pirates}) to assist you for a single adventure. The captain has a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobSailingShi]{Sailing Ship}, but you need to hire additional crew (at your own expense) to use the ship. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Bilgewater Cartel increases.

Horde Subfactions.name: Horde Subfactions
Horde Subfactions.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.0mXAXee6Uy5ZBdec classes="noborder"]

The Horde is made up of members of many different species, and the most prominent among those species are the subfactions of the Horde. These subfactions are generally identified by their capital city, as shown on the list below. The species descriptions in chapter 2 provide more information about these subfactions.

Horde Subfactions

  • Bilgewater Cartel (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowGoblin0000000]{goblins})

  • Dark Talons (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDracthyr00000]{dracthyr})

  • Darkspear Tribe (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTroll00000000]{trolls})

  • Huojin (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowPandaren00000]{pandaren})

  • Orgrimmar (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowOrc0000000000]{orcs} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowVulpera000000]{vulpera})

  • Silvermoon City (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowElf0000000000.JournalEntryPage.aobPGJElQvOcdSnH]{blood elves})

  • Thunder Bluff (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTauren0000000]{tauren})

  • Undercity (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowForsaken00000]{Forsaken})

If your species gives you a starting Renown Score with a Horde subfaction, gaining renown with different Horde subfactions also increases your Renown Score with your starting faction as described below:

Friendly. The first time your Renown Score with each Horde faction other than your starting faction reaches 3, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 1.

Honored. The first time your Renown Score with each Horde faction other than your starting faction reaches 10, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 2.

Revered. The first time your Renown Score with each Horde faction other than your starting faction reaches 25, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 3.

Exalted. The first time your Renown Score with each Horde faction other than your starting faction reaches 50, increase your Renown Score with your starting faction by 5.

Dark Talons Renown Perks.name: Dark Talons Renown Perks
Dark Talons Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacDarkTalons]{Dark Talons} is the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowDracthyr00000.JournalEntryPage.XQNim1D5Yywg4kS4]{dracthyr weyrn} that has joined the Horde, led by Scalecommander Cindrethresh.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Dark Talons gives you the following additional benefits.

Dark Talons: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Dark Talons

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Draconic or gain proficiency in History (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Dark Talons: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Dark Talons

You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowStrikeOfTheEa]{Strike of the Earth-Warder}. This Blessing improves your Unarmed Strikes, giving you a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with them and increasing the saving throw DC of your Grapple and Shove options by 1. You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Dark Talons falls below 10.

Dark Talons: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Dark Talons

You can request a Charm from the leaders of the Dark Talons before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowCharmofTerr3J]{Charm of Terror}, and it lasts until you use it three times or you complete or abandon the quest. You can take a Magic action to release a wave of terror. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a [[/save 15 wis]] saving throw or have the &Reference[Frightened] condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can’t make Opportunity Attacks. For its action, it can take only the Dash action or an action to try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Once you request this Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Dark Talons increases.

Dark Talons: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Dark Talons

You can call on a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowBlackDragonpP]{Black Dragonflight Whelp} (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowBestiaryOfAze]{chapter 7}) to assist you for a single adventure. If the dragon is killed, your Renown Score with the Dark Talons is reduced by [[/r 2d6]]. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Dark Talons increases.

Darkspear Tribe Renown Perks.name: Darkspear Tribe Renown Perks
Darkspear Tribe Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacDarkspTrib]{Darkspear} tribe was the first group of @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTroll00000000]{trolls} to join forces with the Horde. Trolls on the Echo Isles (off Durotar) are part of this faction, and the Zandalari Empire, on joining the Horde, aligned with the Darkspears to form a united troll faction. Chieftain Rokhan leads the Darkspear tribe, having succeeded Vol’jin, who died during the third invasion of the Burning Legion.

While your Bastion is anywhere on the Echo Isles or Zandalar, your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowDarkspearTrib]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe gives you the following additional benefits.

Darkspear Tribe: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Darkspear Tribe

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Zandali or gain proficiency in Religion (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Darkspear Tribe: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Darkspear Tribe

During a Short Rest, you can make offerings to the loa revered by trolls to gain a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50#charms]{Charm}. When you finish the rest, make a [[/check religion 15 format=long]]. On a successful check, you gain a Charm that allows you to gain the benefit of one of the following Potions as a Bonus Action (choose when you gain the Charm): @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfAnima]{Potion of Animal Friendship}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfClimb]{Potion of Climbing}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfCompr]{Potion of Comprehension}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfFireB]{Potion of Fire Breath}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgHillPotionOfG]{Potion of Giant Strength} (hill), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfGrowt]{Potion of Growth}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgGreaterPotion]{Potion of Healing} (greater), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowGreaterManaOl]{Potion of Mana} (greater), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfPugil]{Potion of Pugilism}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfResis]{Potion of Resistance} (your choice of damage type), or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfWater]{Potion of Water Breathing}.

The Charm vanishes from you after you use it, if you use this feature again, or if your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe falls below 10. Once you receive a Charm in this way, you can’t gain another until your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe increases.

Darkspear Tribe: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Darkspear Tribe

When you request a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50#charms]{Charm} from the loa, you can choose from the following additional Potion effects for your Charm: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfClair]{Potion of Clairvoyance}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfDimin]{Potion of Diminution}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfGaseo]{Potion of Gaseous Form}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgFirePotionOfG]{Potion of Giant Strength} (fire), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgSuperiorPotio]{Potion of Healing} (superior), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowSuperiorManBu]{Potion of Mana} (superior), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfHeroi]{Potion of Heroism}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfInvis]{Potion of Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfInvul]{Potion of Invulnerability}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgPotionOfMindR]{Potion of Mind Reading}.

If you choose one of the options listed above, the Charm vanishes from you if your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe falls below 25.

Darkspear Tribe: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Darkspear Tribe

You can call on a shadow hunter (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmCultistHieroph]{Cultist Hierophant}) and six hexxers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmCultistFanatic]{Cultist Fanatic}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe increases.

Huojin Renown Perks.name: Huojin Renown Perks
Huojin Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacHuojin0000]{Huojin} faction, led by Ji Firepaw, represents those pandaren who side with the Horde.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Huojin gives you the following additional benefits.

Huojin: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Huojin

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn the Pandaren language or gain proficiency with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulBrewersSup]{Brewer’s Supplies} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulCooksUtens]{Cook’s Utensils} (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Huojin: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Huojin

You have Advantage on Initiative rolls as long as your Renown Score with the Huojin is 10+.

Huojin: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Huojin

You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBlessingOfHea]{Blessing of Health} (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide). You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Huojin falls below 25.

Huojin: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Huojin

A group of Huojin monks establishes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.bastions.Item.dmgTrainingArea0]{Training Area} special facility in your Bastion. This facility doesn’t count toward the total number of special facilities in your Bastion. The monks depart and the facility becomes unusable if your Renown Score with the Huojin falls below 50.

Orgrimmar Renown Perks.name: Orgrimmar Renown Perks
Orgrimmar Renown Perks.text:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacOrgrimmar0]{Orgrimmar} is the capital city of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowOrc0000000000]{orcs} in Azeroth and is practically synonymous with the Horde. Most orcs across Azeroth consider themselves citizens of Orgrimmar, including the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowOrc0000000000.JournalEntryPage.VO5saYHkKAtVxd2E]{Mag’har orcs} who recently joined the Horde. The orc shaman Thrall founded Orgrimmar and now leads the faction once again, after abdicating for a time in favor of Garrosh Hellscream and then Varok Saurfang.

While your Bastion is in Orgrimmar or elsewhere in Durotar (except the Echo Isles), your Renown Score with Orgrimmar @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowOrgrimmarBast]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Orgrimmar gives you the following additional benefits.

Orgrimmar: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Orgrimmar

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Orcish, Orcish Sign Language, or Vulpera or to gain proficiency with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulLeatherwor]{Leatherworker’s Tools} (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Orgrimmar: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Orgrimmar

When you use leatherworking to @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.nU1WTM5HGXiF9C9k]{craft an item}, the time required to craft it is halved.

Orgrimmar: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Orgrimmar

You can request a Blessing from the leaders of Orgrimmar before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive one of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.U9qU1oUFTPAK7g50#blessings]{Blessings} described in the Dungeon Master’s Guide, and it lasts until you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request a Blessing, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Orgrimmar increases.

Orgrimmar: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Orgrimmar

You can call on a warband leader (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmBerserkerComma]{Berserker Commander}), a shaman (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmElementalCulti]{Elemental Cultist}), and three experienced warriors (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmBerserker00000]{Berserkers}), all mounted on @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmDireWolf000000]{Dire Wolves}, to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Orgrimmar increases.

Silvermoon City Renown Perks.name: Silvermoon City Renown Perks
Silvermoon City Renown Perks.text:
As the capital of the kingdom of Quel’Thalas, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacSilverCity]{Silvermoon City} represents the entirety of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowElf0000000000.JournalEntryPage.aobPGJElQvOcdSnH]{blood elf} kingdom, as well as other blood elves who have aligned themselves with the Horde. Regent Lord Lor’themar Theron has ruled the kingdom since the fall of Prince Kael’thas Sunstrider, who made a traitorous pact with the Burning Legion. The nightborne elves of Suramar are also considered part of this faction.

While your Bastion is in Silvermoon City, elsewhere in Quel’Thalas, or in Suramar, your Renown Score with Silvermoon City @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowSilvermoonCit]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Silvermoon City gives you the following additional benefits.

Silvermoon City: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Silvermoon City

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Shalassian or Thalassian or to gain proficiency with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulCarpenters]{Carpenter’s Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulPottersToo]{Potter’s Tools}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulWoodcarver]{Woodcarver’s Tools} (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Silvermoon City: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Silvermoon City

When you use enchanting to @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.nU1WTM5HGXiF9C9k]{craft an item}, the time required to craft it is halved.

Silvermoon City: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Silvermoon City

You can request a Charm from the leaders of Silvermoon City before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a Charm that duplicates the effect of one of the following Wands: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfBinding]{Wand of Binding}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfEnemyDe]{Wand of Enemy Detection}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfFear000]{Wand of Fear}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfFirebal]{Wand of Fireballs}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfLightni]{Wand of Lightning Bolts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfMagicMi]{Wand of Magic Missiles}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfParalys]{Wand of Paralysis}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfPolymor]{Wand of Polymorph}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgWandOfWeb0000]{Wand of Web}. The Charm doesn’t regain charges. It vanishes from you if you spend all its charges, if you complete or abandon the quest, or if your Renown Score with Silvermoon City falls below 25. Once you request a Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Silvermoon City increases.

Silvermoon City: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Silvermoon City

You can call on a single Magister (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmArchmage000000]{Archmage}) or four @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmMage0000000000]{Mages} to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Silvermoon City increases.

Thunder Bluff Renown Perks.name: Thunder Bluff Renown Perks
Thunder Bluff Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacThundeBluf]{Thunder Bluff} faction represents those united tauren tribes who have aligned themselves with the Horde, including the Highmountain tauren of the Broken Isles and some taunka of Northrend. The leader of the faction is High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof, who succeeded his father, Cairne Bloodhoof, when Cairne died in an ill-fated duel against Garrosh Hellscream.

While your Bastion is in Thunder Bluff or elsewhere in Mulgore or Highmountain, your Renown Score with Thunder Bluff @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowThunderBluffB]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Thunder Bluff gives you the following additional benefits.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.vZzitaEOlQewAlPQ caption=false classes="noborder"]

Thunder Bluff: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Thunder Bluff

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Taur-ahe or gain proficiency with the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulHerbalismK]{Herbalism Kit} (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Thunder Bluff: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Thunder Bluff

When you succeed on a check to gather herbs using @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.ywSgJFsinrEDfTDk#herbalism]{herbalism}, you gain one extra resource, and you find a rare resource if you beat the check DC by 4 or more.

Thunder Bluff: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Thunder Bluff

You can request the Charm of An’she from the leaders of Thunder Bluff before you undertake a quest on their behalf. This Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonBeas]{Summon Beast} (level 3 version). Once used three times, the Charm vanishes from you; it also vanishes if you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request a Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Thunder Bluff increases.

Thunder Bluff: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Thunder Bluff

You can call on a tauren shaman (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmElementalCulti]{Elemental Cultist}) and eight assistant shaman (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmBerserker00000]{Berserkers}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Thunder Bluff increases.

Undercity Renown Perks.name: Undercity Renown Perks
Undercity Renown Perks.text:
The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.actors.Actor.wowfacUndercity0]{Undercity} faction encompasses the Forsaken aligned with the Horde. The faction was long led by Sylvanas Windrunner, who originally led the Forsaken who broke free from the control of the Lich King. When Sylvanas stepped into the leadership of the Horde as warchief, the Desolate Council was formed to govern the Forsaken in her place. The council, based now in the Ruins of Lordaeron, is made up of five leaders: Calia Menethil, Lilian Voss, Master Apothecary Faranell, Deathstalker Commander Belmont, and Dark Ranger Velonara.

While your Bastion is in Undercity or the Ruins of Lordaeron, your Renown Score with Undercity @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowUndercityBast]{increases by 1}.

Increasing your Renown Score with Undercity gives you the following additional benefits.

Undercity: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with Undercity

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn the Forsaken language or gain proficiency with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulAlchemists]{Alchemist’s Supplies} (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Undercity: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with Undercity

When you use alchemy to @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowProfessionsAn.JournalEntryPage.nU1WTM5HGXiF9C9k]{craft an item}, the time required to craft it is halved.

Undercity: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Undercity

You can request the Charm of the Banshee from the leaders of Undercity before you undertake a quest on their behalf. This Charm allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonUnde]{Summon Undead}. Once used three times, the Charm vanishes from you; it also vanishes if you complete or abandon the quest. Once you request a Charm, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Undercity increases.

Undercity: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with Undercity

You can call on two Forsaken necromancers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmGhastGravecall]{Ghast Gravecallers}) and five unliving soldiers (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmWight000000000]{Wight}) to assist you for a single adventure. Once you request this assistance, you can’t do so again until your Renown Score with Undercity increases.

Introduction.name: Introduction
Introduction.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.o4AzWkQiDJs3OqTJ caption=false classes="noborder"]

The planet called Azeroth floats through the Material Plane—what its scholars call the Great Dark Beyond. This plane of existence, the physical universe, is an infinite living realm composed of innumerable stars, worlds, and mortal civilizations. Some worlds, like Azeroth, have souls, and the titans believe that these Worldsouls, properly nourished, will eventually develop into more titans.

The Twisting Nether is how sages of Azeroth refer to the Wildspace of the Astral Plane: a parallel dimension to the Great Dark Beyond, defined by perpetual strife between the cosmic forces of @UUID[.39WbPfMoJEVvbg15]{Light and Shadow}. At times, the volatile magic that pervades the Twisting Nether intrudes on the physical universe, warping reality beyond measure.

The Cosmic Forces.name: The Cosmic Forces
The Cosmic Forces.text: Beyond the Great Dark Beyond and the Twisting Nether, various cosmic forces inhabit their own extradimensional realms. The conflicts among these forces shape the nature of reality on the Material Plane. These forces include both elemental substance and spiritual energy—comparable to the influence of the I@UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgCosmology0000.JournalEntryPage.3IN4pWA8s8Dz6IG2#inner-planes]{nner and Outer Planes} described in the Dungeon Master’s Guide—and they are best understood as pairs or groups of oppositional forces.

Order and Disorder.name: Order and Disorder
Order and Disorder.text:
The forces of Order and Disorder govern the cosmic systems of the universe. Order is most commonly perceived as arcane magic. This type of energy is intensely volatile, and wielding it requires precision and concentration.

Disorder manifests as highly destructive fel magic. This brutal and addictive energy is fueled by drawing life from living beings. @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.mOeoKWAu3OOx8LP9]{The Burning Legion} is the ultimate expression of Disorder in the physical world.

The Pantheon

Titans are colossal, godlike beings of Order, composed of the primordial matter from which the universe was born.

A group of titans called the Pantheon (or the Pantheon of Order) roam the cosmos, imbued with the raw power of creation. The titans use this incredible force to find and awaken others of their kind who still slumber, in the form of Worldsouls, among the many worlds of the Great Dark. These titans created the keepers, lesser but still godlike beings who shaped and ordered Azeroth, created the other titan-forged, and empowered the Dragon Aspects.

The original pantheon included seven titans, all but one of whom imbued one or more keepers with their likeness and power:

Aman’Thul, Highfather of the Pantheon, has mastery over time magic. His keepers are Odyn and Ra.

Eonar the Life-Binder is the protector of life, nature, and health. Her keeper is Freya.

Golganneth the Thunderer is the lord of the skies and oceans. His keepers are Hodir and Thorim.

Khaz’goroth, the Shaper and Forger of Worlds, is the ultimate artisan and guardian of the deep places of the world. His keeper is Archaedas.

Norgannon, known as Keeper of Celestial Magic and Lore, is the master of all magic, knowledge, secrets, and mysteries. His keepers are Loken and Mimiron.

Sargeras, known first as the Defender and then as the Destroyer, was the champion of the Pantheon until he decided that the only way to prevent the void lords from corrupting a Worldsoul and making titans of their own was to destroy the cosmos and start creation over again. To that end, he created the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.mOeoKWAu3OOx8LP9]{Burning Legion}.

Aggramar, the Avenger, was the lieutenant of Sargeras and inherited his role as champion of the Pantheon. He is charged with combating the Burning Legion. His keeper is Tyr.

Light and Shadow.name: Light and Shadow
Light and Shadow.text:
Light and Shadow are fundamental forces. Although contradictory by nature, they are bound together on a cosmic scale; neither can exist without the other. Pure Light and Shadow dwell in realms outside the borders of reality, but manifestations of their presence are found in the physical universe. Light manifests as holy magic, while Shadow (also referred to as “the Void”) appears as shadow magic.

Naaru

The naaru are benevolent creatures of living holy energy. They are perhaps the purest expression of the Light that exists in the Great Dark Beyond. The naaru have vowed to bring peace and hope to all mortal civilizations and waylay the forces of the Void that seek to engulf creation.

Church of the Holy Light

In the wake of a devastating war against the trolls of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTroll00000000.JournalEntryPage.AdBTf7AxlTOG09N7]{Amani Empire} millennia ago, a group of humans received visions of strange angelic beings who introduced them to the Light. These beings were the naaru, and these encounters led to the foundation of the religion that commands the loyalty of most humans on Azeroth: the Church of the Holy Light. This faith was codified in a series of holy texts, teaching the three virtues of respect, tenacity, and compassion, based on the idea that the Light dwells in all living things.

Since its founding, the faith of the Holy Light has spread to the high elves of Quel’Thalas and the dwarves of Khaz Modan.

Void Lords

The void lords are monstrous entities composed of pure Shadow energy. These beings are cruel and merciless beyond mortal comprehension. Driven by an insatiable hunger, the void lords seek to devour all matter and energy in the physical universe.

In their natural state, the void lords exist outside reality. Only the most powerful of these entities can manifest in the physical universe, and only for limited amounts of time. To maintain their presence in reality, the void lords must consume untold amounts of matter and energy.

Old Gods. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.QX2LRHkL98AMmC55]{Old Gods} are physical manifestations of the Void. They are nightmares incarnate: mountains of blighted flesh and writhing tentacles that grow like cancers within the worlds of the Great Dark Beyond. These malignant entities serve the void lords by transforming the worlds they infest into places of despair and death.

Twilight’s Hammer. Twilight’s Hammer is a cult that reveres the Old Gods and seeks to bring about the end of the world. It has been active since before the First War, but it grew to particular prominence amid the cataclysmic events surrounding the return of Deathwing.

The Elements.name: The Elements
The Elements.text:
The elements of air, earth, fire, and water serve as the basic building blocks of all matter in the universe. Shaman call on the primordial forces of Spirit and Decay to attain power over the elements. Those who seek to bring balance to the elements rely on Spirit (sometimes referred to as the “fifth element” by shaman). This life-giving force interconnects and binds all things in existence as one. Decay is the tool of shaman seeking to subjugate and weaponize the elements.

Elemental Spirits

Elemental spirits are wild and chaotic beings of air, earth, fire, or water. They were among the first sentient creatures to inhabit the nascent worlds of the waking universe. They appear in an almost infinite variety of shapes and sizes, with personalities and temperaments strongly influenced by the spirit’s elemental nature. The mightiest of these elemental spirits are the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.DUxMQYjqDUIm5sGd]{elemental lords}.

Life and Death.name: Life and Death
Life and Death.text:
The forces of Life and Death hold sway over every living thing in the physical universe. The energies of Life, known commonly as nature magic, promote growth and renewal. Death, in the form of necromantic magic, breeds despair in mortal hearts and pushes everything toward a state of entropic decay and eventual oblivion.

Elune

Elune, called the Mother Moon and the Night Warrior, is the primary deity of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowElf0000000000.JournalEntryPage.C4fRQxnWgEHPPK1W]{night elves} of Kalimdor. @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTauren0000000]{Tauren} also revere her as Mu’sha, the left eye of the Earth Mother. Mu’sha’s twin, An’she, is the right eye (the sun), a force of Light.

Wild Gods

Wild Gods are primal manifestations of Life and nature. They are creatures of two realms, inhabiting the physical world of Azeroth while their spirits are bound to the ethereal Emerald Dream. Many Wild Gods appear in the form of enormous animals, such as wolves, bears, tigers, or birds.

Eternal Ones

The Eternal Ones, who rule the afterlife realms of the Shadowlands, are incarnations of the cosmic force of Death, and they’re sometimes known as the Pantheon of Death (in contrast to the titans of the Pantheon of Order, described below).

Troll.name: Troll
Troll.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.Botdf740ywBDOR5y caption=false classes="hide-in-embed noborder"]

Trolls are among Azeroth’s oldest peoples. From their earliest days, they revered the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheWorldOfWar.JournalEntryPage.Jm2kfPalxs8mphjd#wild-gods]{Wild Gods} of nature, which they called “loa”—a name they later applied to a wide variety of beings and spirits they worship and serve.

The first center of troll society was in the mountainous region of Zandalar, where trolls established the city of Zuldazar thousands of years before the Great Sundering. Even as Zuldazar flourished, troll tribes spread across the entire continent, claiming vast swaths of territory. The tribes briefly united to battle the insectoid aqir—minions of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.QX2LRHkL98AMmC55]{Old Gods}—and drive them underground.

After this war, the leaders of Zandalar convinced the most prominent and power-hungry tribes to establish permanent strongholds across Azeroth to keep the aqir in check. The Amani, Drakkari, and Gurubashi heeded this call, establishing the strongholds of Zul’Aman, Zul’Drak, and Zul’Gurub, respectively, as the capitals of their new empires.

The Amani Empire occupied the plains and forests of the northeast, and its people became known as forest trolls. The Gurubashi Empire was based in the southeast but spread west as far as Zul’Farrak, and its people became known as jungle trolls. The Drakkari Empire in the north was made up of ice trolls. Another group of trolls, called dark trolls, dwelled underground near Mount Hyjal and in other places in the west. Some believe that a group of dark trolls dwelling near the Well of Eternity were transformed into the first night elves.

The Great Sundering isolated the troll empires and tribes from each other. It also split the Gurubashi Empire in half, with those in the west adapting to the new desert climate of their home to become sand trolls. Mighty Zandalar was reduced to a tiny island with little influence on the other troll nations.

In the ages after the Great Sundering, the Amani trolls warred against the high elves of Quel’Thalas, the Gurubashi pushed back against human incursion from Stormwind into Stranglethorn, and the Zandalari explored the islands near their home, leading them to enslave the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowGoblin0000000]{goblins} of Kezan for a time. The tribes that made up the Gurubashi empire warred with each other, particularly when some turned to the service of Hakkar the Soulflayer, the Loa of Blood.

With the exception of Zandalar, the great troll empires now lie largely in ruins, splintered once more into their component tribes. Even so, each of the ancient fortresses is still inhabited by trolls.

Trolls average over seven feet tall, with a lithe and slender build, long limbs, and prominent tusks. Their large, long ears are often pierced or otherwise decorated. The different offshoots of trollkind vary in coloration: The jungle trolls of Gurubashi (including the Darkspear tribe) range from sickly green to bruised purple, with ghostly shades of blue in between. Their hair is typically a more vibrant shade in the same range. Forest trolls are slightly shorter than other trolls and uniformly green in coloration, thanks to a moss that grows on their skin. Ice trolls’ skin ranges from blue to white, but their hair can be almost any color. The sand trolls of Zul’Farrak and Tanaris have brown or gold skin. And Zandalari trolls have green, blue, gray, or black skin.

Darkspear Trolls.name: Darkspear Trolls
Darkspear Trolls.text: The first trolls to join the Horde were jungle trolls of the Darkspear tribe, driven out of Stranglethorn in fierce conflicts with other tribes of the Gurubashi Empire. They initially settled on a remote island, but when Thrall led the liberated orcs to Kalimdor, he offered the Darkspear tribe a place in the Horde’s new domain. The Darkspear trolls settled on the Echo Isles, just off the coast of Durotar.

Zandalari Trolls.name: Zandalari Trolls
Zandalari Trolls.text: Originally established by the first troll tribe, from which all other troll tribes descend, the ancient Zandalari Empire is steeped in ritual and spirituality. Its warriors ride mighty dinosaurs into battle, and the Zandalari Empire’s Golden Fleet is one of the foremost naval forces on Azeroth. But as enemies encroached on the borders of Zuldazar, and unrest threatened to topple the empire, agents of the Horde stepped in and ushered a new queen to the Zandalari throne. Under Queen Talanji’s rule, the Zandalari Empire has joined the Horde and taken its place among the great kingdoms of Azeroth.

Amani Trolls.name: Amani Trolls
Amani Trolls.text: The forest trolls of Zul’Aman, after centuries of war with the elves of Quel’Thalas, recently forged an uneasy alliance with the blood elves against common enemies serving the Void. These trolls remain suspicious of outsiders, but some have ventured out from their ancestral lands to learn more of the world beyond their borders.

Troll Renown.name: Troll Renown
Troll Renown.text: If you choose the Darkspear troll or Zandalari troll Troll Lineage, your Renown Score with the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheHorde00000.JournalEntryPage.zGI02pOayz0wbpis]{Darkspear Tribe} (Horde) begins at 3. Otherwise, you have no starting Renown Score.

Introduction.name: Introduction
Introduction.text:
The Valdrakken Accord is the unified might of all dragonkind, seeking to protect not only the Dragon Isles but all of Azeroth according to the ancient charge given to the five @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.2MFeGdKlqPZz0K4s#dragon-aspects]{Dragon Aspects}. The accord has also expanded its mission to include dragons beyond the five flights—in particular those who follow Vyranoth, who has been empowered as the Aspect of Storms.

The mission of the Dragon Aspects means that what is good for dragonkind is generally beneficial for all of Azeroth. The dragons oppose the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.mOeoKWAu3OOx8LP9]{Burning Legion}, the lingering forces of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowConflictsOfAz.JournalEntryPage.QX2LRHkL98AMmC55]{Old Gods} and elementals they have corrupted, the remnants of the Scourge, the powers of the Void, and any other force that might threaten Azeroth and its inhabitants. That said, working with the dragons means viewing the world’s conflicts from their perspective (which is generally Neutral) and solving problems their way.

The leaders of the Valdrakken Accord are the six Dragon Aspects: Alexstrasza, Nozdormu, Kalecgos, Merithra, Ebyssian, and Vyranoth. Their base of operations is the city of Valdrakken in the Dragon Isles.

Before the Dragon Isles reappeared, the Wyrmrest Accord carried out a similar mission but without the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowBestiaryOfAze.JournalEntryPage.jnGTp7LiVzQO8DTY]{black dragonflight}.

Valdrakken Accord Renown Perks.name: Valdrakken Accord Renown Perks
Valdrakken Accord Renown Perks.text:
Establishing your Bastion in Valdrakken or elsewhere in the Dragon Isles increases your Renown Score with the Valdrakken Accord by 1.

Increasing your Renown Score with the Valdrakken Accord gives you the following additional benefits.

Valdrakken Accord: Friendly

Prerequisite: Renown 3+ with the Valdrakken Accord

You can spend 30 days with a trainer to learn Draconic (see the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheAlliance00.JournalEntryPage.atJHGssGcTvG0dWQ]{Training} sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Valdrakken Accord: Honored

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Valdrakken Accord

You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowBlessingProto]{Blessing of the Proto-Whelp}. This Blessing allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar} with no Material components. When you cast the spell in this way, your familiar is a crimson proto-whelp (@UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmPseudodragon00]{Pseudodragon}). Once you cast the spell in this way, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You lose the Blessing and your proto-whelp familiar vanishes if your Renown Score with the Valdrakken Accord falls below 10.

Also, if you establish your Bastion in the Dragon Isles, it includes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.bastions.Item.dmgGarden0000000]{Garden} special facility. This facility doesn’t count toward the total number of special facilities in your Bastion. The hireling departs and the facility becomes unusable if your Renown Score with Valdrakken Accord falls below 10.

Valdrakken Accord: Revered

Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Valdrakken Accord

You receive the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowBlessingWylde]{Blessing of the Wylderdrake}. This Blessing allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFindSteed0]{Find Steed} (level 4 version). The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobOtherworld]{Otherworldly Steed} summoned by the spell is a cliffside wylderdrake, which has the Dragon type, deals Force damage with its Otherworldly Stlam, and has the following trait instead of the Bonus Action options shown in the Player’s Handbook:

Flyby. The steed doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

Valdrakken Accord: Exalted

Prerequisite: Renown 50+ with the Valdrakken Accord

The Valdrakken Accord grants you the title Ally of Dragons. Dragons are &Reference[Friendly] to you by default unless they are corrupted. You can petition one of the Dragon Aspects for a favor, which takes the form of a Wish spell. Once you are granted such a favor, you can’t ask for another one, even if your Renown Score falls below 50 and later reaches 50 again.

Vulpera.name: Vulpera
Vulpera.text:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowArtHandouts00.JournalEntryPage.qHsRV1Ytg2nMmq5r classes="hide-in-embed noborder"]

Vulpera are small, fox-like people native to the deserts of Vol’dun. Traveling in close-knit caravans, their wagons pulled by alpacas, vulpera watch out for each other as they scavenge supplies from across the dunes. Despite their small stature, they are fierce and cunning in battle, bringing down any enemy foolish enough to underestimate them.

Despite this ferocity, the vulpera have long been terrorized by the serpentine sethrak. During the Fourth War, the Horde helped a group of vulpera strike a decisive blow against their sethrak oppressors, leading the grateful vulpera to seek admittance into @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.book.JournalEntry.wowTheHorde00000]{the Horde}. After proving that they could be useful to the Horde, they were admitted.

Vulpera stand under five feet tall and resemble foxes walking upright, with slender muzzles, large ears, and bushy tails. Their fur ranges from gold or orange to white or dark gray, usually lighter on the front.
